description: The trail back up a record hierarchy, e.g. Library / Reports / Q3. Routing agnostic: pass `href` for anchors, `onSelect` for buttons. The last item is always the current page (aria-current), not a link. Replaces the old habit of faking a breadcrumb with a subtitle string. Copy: each crumb is the page's own title, unshortened. A trail that renames its steps is a trail the reader cannot match to where they have been.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark. Default "Breadcrumb".

example:
<Breadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: 'Library', onSelect: () => undefined },
    { label: 'Reports', onSelect: () => undefined },
    { label: 'Q3 revenue' },
  ]}
/>
